definitions.explanation: The area close to something or someone.
Close to a number or amount.

examples.japanese: 3⟦{万|まん}→万：00795_man⟧⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧{近|ちか}く⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。

examples.english: I went shopping at a nearby store.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{近|ちか}く⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: A new convenience store opened near the school.

examples.japanese: 1⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧{近|ちか}く⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I've been living in Japan for nearly a year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦{遅|おそ}く→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{働|はたら}いて→働く：00503_hataraku⟧、12⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧{近|ちか}く⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}った→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: I worked until late at night and got home close to midnight.

notes:
{近|ちか}く has two main uses: "nearby/vicinity" (location) and "nearly/almost" (approximate amount).

LOCATION USE:
- ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{近|ちか}く: near the station
- {近|ちか}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧: nearby shop
- ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{近|ちか}く: around here

APPROXIMATION USE:
- 100⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧{近|ちか}く: nearly 100 people
- 1⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧{近|ちか}く: nearly an hour
- 3⟦{万|まん}→万：00795_man⟧⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧{近|ちか}く: close to 30,000 yen

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{付近|ふきん}→付近：00044_fukin⟧: vicinity (more formal)
- ⟦{辺|あた}り→辺り：01770_atari⟧: area, around
- ⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧: neighborhood
- ⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧: near (adjective)

USAGE:
{近|ちか}く can modify nouns with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: {近|ちか}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun.
